---
title: "Faras Ki Zeen Se Beshak Utar Gaye Haiṅ Husain"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
poet: "Akbar"
reciter: "Mir Hasan Mir"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Faras ki zeen se beshak utar gaye hai hussain
zameen dhoond rahi hai kidhar gaye hai hussain

1
karega shimr ka khanjar to sirf sar ko juda
wagar na laashae akbar pe margaye hai hussain

2
sare bureeda katay hont khoon chehre par
ajeeb haal may shireen ke ghar gaye hai hussain

3
mai milne shaam ke zindan may aaunga tujhse
ye baat aakhri beti se kar gaye hai hussain

4
kahin hai qasim o abbas aur kahin akbar
kahan kahan tere tukde bikhar gaye hai hussain

5
qaza ke baad bhi bhai behan ke saath raha
jidhar jidhar gayi zainab udhar gaye hai hussain

6
kisi ne maara hai pathar behan ke kya akbar
jo karte karte tilaawat teher gaye hai hussain

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/faras-ki-zeen-se-nw-d6ae51f2f9b9.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---\\n', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, digits in [(roman, '123456'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵۶')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in '\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in edition.splitlines()).strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [2] + [3]*6
    assert ''.join(block[0] for block in blocks[1:]) == digits
assert '\\u200c' not in body and 'noUrdu' not in front
print('Verified opening and six numbered couplets in both editions.')
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu script in the selected lyric and moved the Roman transcription to `romanLyrics`, preserving its wording and normalizing capitalization. Both editions contain the opening couplet and six numbered couplets in the same order.

Updated the title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`. I read “sare bureeda” as `سرِ بریدہ` and kept “behan ke kya” as `بہن کے کیا`.
